title: Physics-guided data-driven scheduler of switching coefficients for near-time-optimal relay control of a positioning electric drive: code and data
description: Simulation code, oracle labels, trained models, evaluation results, tables, figures and a deployable C implementation that reproduce the article “Physics-guided data-driven scheduler of switching coefficients for near-time-optimal relay control of a positioning electric drive” (submitted, 2026). The archive contains a model of a DC positioning drive with a relay cascade synthesised by the N-i switching method, simulation-based optimisation of the switching coefficients, a physics-guided scheduler (square-root scaling law plus a residual multilayer-perceptron ensemble), baselines, an ablation study, the evaluation on 2500 test moves, the minimum settling time of the model by linear programming, non-idealities (load torque, controller sampling, supply error), the export of the scheduler to a verified self-contained C component and the profiling of the pipeline. See README.md for instructions.
